label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Two promo popups (newsletter and 20 percent off teaser) grabbed focus on first Tab and again on the next page; a cookie banner I had to decline was reachable only after tabbing through the popup.
[name] options are many separate Tab stops with unlabelled radio and plain div swatches, and the price is also a stop; about 12 Tab presses before Add to Cart.

After Add to Cart the cart drawer opened with focus on Close, and the Checkout button is far down behind many unnamed links, Add buttons that do not name their product, and dozens of variant buttons; I could not reach it by Tab and only found it by going backwards from the top of the drawer.
The header Cart button did not seem to open the drawer on the first press, giving no feedback, and unnamed links appeared in the drawer.
Auto-rotating carousels and a long list of image zoom buttons add many Tab stops before the main purchase controls.
